entities.summary: Jan Rommel Osuna Roberto, professionally known as Jak Roberto, is a Filipino actor, model and singer. He was a member of the boy band 3LOGY with actors Jeric Gonzales and Abel Estanislao. He is best known for playing Andres "Andoy" dela Cruz in the 2017 drama series Meant to Be. He is currently an exclusive artist of GMA Network and is the brother of actress Sanya Lopez.
